info.name: One Degree Resource Server Housing Opportunities API

params.name: page
params.description: The page offset. Default is 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return. Default is 10.

params.name: titles_only
params.description: Return only titles/basic info instead of full resource objects.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated set of IDs whose records will be returned.

params.name: query[text]
params.description: Full-text search keywords. Surround in quotes for exact phrase.

params.name: query[tags]
params.description: Classification tags associated with opportunities.

params.name: query[lat]
params.description: Latitude around which to search.

params.name: query[long]
params.description: Longitude around which to search.

params.name: query[distance]
params.description: Radius in kilometers around the coordinates to search within.

params.name: query[order]
params.description: Ordering of results (default scored by best match, distance and other factors).

params.name: query[match]
params.description: Match logic: any, properties, or by_type.

items.docs: Returns a collection of opportunities (services/programs). Supports full-text, geo, tag, and property search.
